senses.gloss: (Pilp. of גמם) [to peel, scrape; trnsf., cmp. חֲסַם II, חָכַךְ] to hesitate, stammer, to speak with an expression of uncertainty or of scruple.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 30a:15">Kidd. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>אל תְּגַמְגֵּם ותאמר לו</he> that thou need not hesitate in answering him; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 34">Sifré Deut. 34</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 22a:8">Ber. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>היה מְגַמְגֵּם למעלה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. a. Rashi <he>מג׳ וקורא</he>) was speaking hesitatingly over (as the Amora of) R. Judah &c.

<cite ref="Berakhot 22b:15">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>מג׳ וקורא</he> he should read in a hesitating manner (rapidly murmuring); Y. ib. III, 6ᶜ bot. <he>התחיל מג׳ בה</he> he commenced stammering over it (hesitating to pronounce the Divine Name). [<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:1:1">Cant. R. to VII, 1</cite> <he>מתגמגם</he>, transpos. of <he>מתמגמג</he>, v. <cite ref="M00113"><he>מָגַג</he></cite>.]
